text: Optical engineering is an engineering discipline centered around the generation, transmission, regulation, detection and application of light. It integrates knowledge from various fields such as physics, electronic science, materials science, and precision machinery, aiming to solve practical engineering problems through optical principles and promoting innovative applications of optoelectronic technology in areas like communication, healthcare, energy, and national defense. From everyday items like cameras and laser printers to advanced equipment such as lithography machines and satellite remote sensing systems, all rely on the technical support of optical engineering.
